# Moondust Ink

> Private color realism tattoo studio in Berlin, run by tattoo artist Aylin. Specializes in color realism, Korean-style tattooing, and color micro-realism, plus original paintings on canvas ("Art"). Content is available in English and Russian.

Moondust Ink is the studio brand of tattoo artist Aylin (Instagram: @a.moondust.ink), originally from Almaty, now based in Berlin. She works by appointment inside Iron City Tattoo Berlin, a resident/guest tattoo studio at Reichenberger Str. 133, 10999 Berlin (Kreuzberg, Germany). Studio hours: Monday–Saturday 12:00–19:00; Wednesday and Sunday by appointment only.

## Pages

- [Home](https://moondust.ink/): Introduction, specialization overview, and links to every section.
- [Portfolio](https://moondust.ink/portfolio): Tattoo work — color realism, Korean style, color micro-realism.
- [Art](https://moondust.ink/art): Paintings on canvas by the same artist.
- [Studio](https://moondust.ink/studio): Studio address, hours, map, and directions.
- [Blog](https://moondust.ink/blog): Short articles on color realism, aftercare, and consultations.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- This is a client-rendered single-page app (React). Page-specific title, description, and Open Graph tags update after JavaScript runs; the initial static HTML reflects the homepage.
- Russian-language content is served from the same URLs as the English content via an in-page language switch (stored in the visitor's browser) rather than separate /ru/ URLs.
- Blog post URL slugs differ between English and Russian; each slug only resolves under its own language.
